description: TCL T-Chord 11.1.6 Tri-Level Spatial Acoustic Matrix & 11-Slot Codec Latency Calibration Table

target_hardware.tv: TCL 75Q9M Pro (MediaTek Pentonic 700 / MT9655 / Android 14 / Onkyo 2.1.2 80W 5-Driver System)
target_hardware.soundbar: TCL Q95K 11.1.4 (Illusonic DSP Type 13 / MediaTek MT8532 / StreamSDK)

acoustic_architecture.target_layout: 11.1.6 IMAX Enhanced & Auro-3D Tri-Level Spatial Matrix
acoustic_architecture.dialogue_elevation_anchor: TV Lower Micro-Transducer Array (Linkwitz-Riley 480Hz HPF + Blauert 3.5kHz Peaking)

layer_allocation.front_height_l_r: Q95K Soundbar Front Up-Firing Reflection Array (Ceiling Angle 20°)
layer_allocation.top_sky_l_r: TCL 75Q9M Pro Onkyo Top-Firing Sky Drivers (Physical 1.45m Elevation, Ceiling Direct)
layer_allocation.rear_height_l_r: Q95K Wireless Satellite Up-Firing Reflection Array (Ceiling Angle 15°)

tri_level_height_matrix.rationale: Combines 4x up-firing reflection drivers from Q95K with 2x physical top sky drivers from TV into a continuous 6-point hemispherical height dome (.6). HRTF reflections disabled (hrtf_enable=0) to prevent room reverberation doubling. Top sky gain balanced to 3dB to prevent ambient background music from masking center dialogue.

crossover_network.rationale: Prevents TV micro-transducer excursion overload (>1.2mm) below 400Hz and eliminates plastic chassis buzz, allocating chest resonance strictly to Q95K 10-inch subwoofer array

blauert_directional_filter.rationale: Activates human pinna directional band (Vorn-Oben) to elevate dialogue phantom center directly across the 40cm gap to display screen midline

icld_level_balance.rationale: Per Wallis & Lee (JAES 2015) and 40cm/2.4m geometry: -7dB TV attenuation ensures robust dialogue presence and elevation without overpowering Q95K soundbar or creating dual-source doubling

dialogue_enhancement.rationale: Engages Dolby MS12 hardware Dialog Enhancer (+10dB) and Volume Leveler (DRC) to bring whisper and speech clarity forward while curbing excessive background music and explosive SFX

peq_filters.description: High-Pass Filter Stage 2 (Cascaded to form Linkwitz-Riley 24dB/oct)
